At Purands AI, we see this firsthand in retention marketing. Accurate AI needs robust data systems. Our AI retention agents sit on top of CRM and CDP, enhancing data accuracy. By focusing on data engineering, we improve AI outcomes. Take win-back campaigns. With precise data, our AI agents identify which customers to re-engage, boosting repeat purchases. topic: Google reports Q2 free cash flow at negative $5.9B amid increased AI spending
body: Google's latest financials reveal a first for the tech giant: a negative free cash flow of $5.9 billion in Q2 2026. This isn't just a number; it's a signal of the massive costs tied to AI investments. As companies chase the AI dream, the infrastructure demands are not trivial. Google's cash burn highlights this. Building and maintaining AI systems is a capital-heavy endeavor. The question is, can the economic model of AI-driven solutions sustain such costs in the long run? For Google, it’s a strategic bet, but one with significant financial implications. The ripple effects may well challenge how businesses plan their own AI investments.

topic: Railway secures $100 million to challenge AWS with AI-native cloud infrastructure
body: Railway just secured $100 million in funding to build AI-native cloud infrastructure, setting its sights on AWS. This isn't just about throwing cash at a cloud competitor. It's about rethinking infrastructure from the ground up with AI at its core. Why does this matter? Traditional cloud giants like AWS weren't designed with AI in mind. They evolved to support AI capabilities, but Railway is building with AI as the starting point. This means potentially more efficient, specialized environments for AI workloads. For AI-driven businesses, the cost and scalability of infrastructure can be make-or-break factors. A cloud service that's built from the start to optimize AI processes could offer more tailored solutions and better performance at lower costs. But let's not overlook the challenges. Competing with giants like AWS isn't just hard - it's brutal. Railway will need to overcome significant technical and operational hurdles to scale effectively. A new player in the cloud space is always interesting, especially one focusing on AI from the get-go. Could this shift the landscape for AI-native applications?
